payload.summary: Planned an automated deployed compatibility gate that observes served frontend and API revisions, exercises direct HTTP, a real CLI subprocess, and a deployed browser, rejects stale retired-route assets, and keeps mutation restricted to explicitly approved staging or ephemeral targets.

decisions.title: Observe revisions from served artifacts
decisions.rationale: Operator labels and deployment metadata do not prove what the network boundary is serving.

decisions.title: Keep production smoke structurally read-only
decisions.rationale: Mutation requires redundant authorization and an exact non-production target classification.

decisions.title: Retain only allowlisted evidence
decisions.rationale: Release proof must not become an artifact containing credentials, headers, queries, or user content.

next_steps: Implement served release identity test-first, then execute each serialized work package and its local verification gate.

relevant_files.description: Revision, browser, mutation, evidence, and CI decisions
